description: This file contains functions for converting legacy dashboard filter scopes into native filters, and for migrating dashboards to use native filters in the Apache Superset project. It includes classes and functions for handling dashboard metadata, filter configurations, and dashboard layout modifications.

methods.name: convert_filter_scopes_to_native_filters
methods.description: Converts legacy filter scopes to native filter configurations for a dashboard.

methods.name: migrate_dashboard
methods.description: Migrates a dashboard to replace legacy filter configurations with native filters and updates layout accordingly.
